author: xenius505
quote: Absolute disgrace to the genre, GTA has never been a "Relationship Simulator" , 15 hours in havnt done nothing but boring stuff for the relationship, GTA is all about crime, good story, good dialogue, good momentum, all of this is absent in this game. Story is terrible, every single dialogue feels written by AI. Characters are blant, pale and boring. Whole thing feels like AI slop to be honest, the physics are absolutely outrageous. Dont know how we came down to this game, after all those classics, but its sad, the end of a legacy.
